entities.name: Ojer Axonil
entities.description: Deep God of the Core of Ixalan, patron of warriors, fire and storms; younger fiery brother of Ojer Taq.

entities.name: Ojer Taq
entities.description: Deep God and elder brother of Ojer Axonil.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: Demon wearing the skin of Axonil's nephew who began the Whispering War and was imprisoned by Axonil.

entities.name: Chimil
entities.description: Deity believed to be parent of the Deep Gods.

entities.name: The Core
entities.description: Home of the Deep Gods on Ixalan.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: Plane where Axonil is a god.

entities.name: Oltec
entities.description: People Axonil has both harmed and defended.

entities.name: Whispering War
entities.description: War begun by Aclazotz after the veil between life and death weakened.

events.summary: After the veil weakens, Aclazotz begins the Whispering War and Axonil, drawn by the battle, is the first god to emerge from the Core.
events.quote: Ojer Axonil was the first god to emerge.

events.summary: Axonil learns Aclazotz is a demon wearing his nephew's skin and warns Ojer Taq.
events.quote: Aclazotz was not his kin, as Axonil expected, but a demon wearing his nephew 's skin.

events.summary: Axonil raises a company of one thousand champions and enters the war.
events.quote: raising a company of one thousand champions to follow him into battle

events.summary: Axonil defeats Aclazotz, tears out an eye and imprisons him away from the Core.
events.quote: Axonil defeated Aclazotz, tearing out one of his eyes and imprisoning him away from the Core.

relations.quote: Axonil is the younger, fiery brother of Ojer Taq .
is the one to have imprisoned the bat god
The Thousand Moons serve as the priests of Ojer Axonil.
